race.comment: FRED ASTERN (7) comes through the right local form after winning a Maiden at this track over 1200m, beating Edika by a length and a half when well found in betting. The move into BM58 grade asks more, but he is third-up, drawn barrier one and already has the track-and-trip win on the board. ZEEMA (10) is the main danger on progression, having improved sharply when third in Class 2 company at this venue, beaten just under two lengths after being big odds. She is still winless at the distance, but her recent-form rating and improving campaign profile keep her right in play. SEATON MOON (8) is the lightly raced threat, winning on debut at Taree as a well-supported favourite after having work to do from back in the field. The new 1200m trip is the genuine test, though there is clear upside. SALMA'S STAR (5) resumed with a narrow third at Bathurst in FM Class 1 grade, travelled well and fought on, and her previous win from her only start at this track keeps her in the each-way mix.
